entities.name: RhD alloimmunization
observations: Maternal anti-D titer 1:32 indicates clinically significant alloimmunization risk in a previously sensitized pregnancy.
MCA peak systolic velocity at 2.0 MoM is strongly suggestive of significant fetal anemia.

source_tools.relevance: Clinical scenario and focused literature search

entities.name: MCA-PSV anemia threshold
observations: MCA peak systolic velocity ≥1.5 MoM is the standard threshold for suspected moderate-to-severe fetal anemia and invasive fetal assessment.
At 2.0 MoM, fetal blood sampling is indicated; intrauterine transfusion follows if anemia is confirmed.

source_tools.relevance: Focused search on Rh alloimmunization management

entities.name: Percutaneous umbilical blood sampling
observations: Cordocentesis is used to directly measure fetal hemoglobin when MCA-PSV suggests significant fetal anemia and permits immediate preparation for transfusion.
